description.p: Imladris is a scientific workbench and polyglot IDE that unifies interactive R, Python, and Julia execution, Quarto publishing, biostatistics, and AI-assisted research into a single studio for researchers, biostatisticians, and data scientists.

Imladris provides adaptive dual-mode operation: a distraction-free single-pane writer for Markdown and HTML, and an RStudio-style 4-quadrant or 6-quadrant ultrawide workbench with multi-screen independent panel popouts for computational documents (.qmd, .Rmd, .ipynb, .R, .py), real-time KaTeX mathematics, live charts, and interactive REPL consoles.

ul.li: 4-Quadrant & 6-Quadrant Ultrawide Workbench: Integrated source editor, interactive R/Python/Julia REPL consoles, variable inspector, live preview, Panel Manager, and independent multi-screen popout windows.
Imladris on Web Offline-First Sync: Share documents to Imladris on Web, work offline, and reconcile changes with git-style commits on reconnect.
Positron/RStudio-Style Direct Editor Writing: In-place code generation and chunk replacement preserving Quarto cell options (#|) and single-step Ctrl+Z undo.

Multi-Tier AI Orchestration: Offline local LLMs via local llama.cpp, Ollama, or LM Studio servers, GitHub Copilot OAuth Device Flow, and automatic HTTP 429 quota failover across Groq, Cerebras, OpenRouter, and GitHub Models.
Reproducible Sandboxes & .mallorn Format: Isolated renv and venv project environments with 1:1 bidirectional RStudio compatibility and portable archive bundles.
Full Jupyter Parity: Lossless round-trip .ipynb (nbformat 4.5) editing preserving cell IDs, execution counts, outputs, and metadata.
Integrated Domain Studios: Galaxy Project workflow bridge, AlphaFold DB structure inspection, ICH E9 biostatistics calculators, and Natural Math/Chem studios.
Scientific Publishing Pipeline: Export to PDF, HTML, OpenDocument Text (.odt), OpenDocument Presentation (.odp), and RTF with cryptographic SHA-256 GxP provenance manifests.
Model Context Protocol (MCP): Hardened built-in stdio MCP server for agentic document analysis and data retrieval.

description.p: AI Transparency & Privacy Disclosure: In-app Elrond AI features are strictly opt-in (supporting 100% offline local inference via llama.cpp/Ollama or consent-gated cloud providers). Imladris is architected and maintained by Antonio De Gaetano with AI pair-programming assistance (Google Gemini and Anthropic Claude) used in developing and auditing source code and documentation.
Note: This application is independently developed and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Posit, RStudio, or Project Jupyter.

description.p: Release 0.43.1 addresses 4-persona beta-testing feedback: persistent multi-screen popout restoration, DataGrid error surfacing, Elbereth unequal-allocation R verification, WebSync conflict resolution & Adw.StatusPage, expanded Command Palette/Shortcuts, and HIG accessibility fixes.
Release 0.43.0 introduces 6-quadrant ultrawide layouts, multi-screen independent panel popouts, Panel Manager, Imladris on Web offline-first sync, and GNOME/Pantheon HIG UI refinements.
Release 0.42.1 fixes the Rich Text (.rtf) creation crash and delivers comprehensive security, thread-safety, and packaging hardening:

ul.li: RTF Creation Crash & Editor Fixes: Fixed null GtkSource.Language SIGSEGV when creating .rtf/.txt/.csv/.tsv files, added native RTF scaffolding, UTF-8/non-BMP codec fixes, crash-recovery snapshotting, and full RTF ribbon/PDF/ODT parity.

Security & Sandbox Hardening: Hardened PluginManager archive/community-registry consent checks and asset confinement, blocked Markdown raw-HTML XSS passthrough in DocumentAdapter, required explicit workspace and output validation in McpServer, and isolated ExportService subprocess environments.
Thread & C Memory Safety: Added per-call PangoFontMap in export_native.c, mutex-guarded static regex caches, and overflow-safe 64-bit disk calculations in toolchain_native.c.
License & Distribution Coherence: Unified Apache-2.0 license metadata across AppStream, NixOS flake, and FlatPark changelogs.

description.p: Release 0.42.0 introduces Elrond AI Hardware Auto-Optimization, the Flatpak Host Bridge with Quarto/R/Python kernel routing, and a redesigned native GTK4/Libadwaita Elrond AI chat panel:

ul.li: Elrond AI Hardware Auto-Optimizer: Automatic 5-tier Vulkan GPU/iGPU/CPU probing via llama-server --list-devices, tailored launch profiles, 15s /health startup monitoring with automatic CPU fallback, and Preferences profile badge.

Flatpak Host Bridge & Kernel Routing: Added HostBridge (--watch-bus orphan prevention), single-shot EnvDiscovery (uv, Conda, venv, multi-version rig R, Quarto), ExecutionRouter with Quarto/R/Python kernel selector, Host/Sandbox scope toggle, and latest unpinned R/CRAN support.

Redesigned Elrond AI Chat UI: Native Adw.ToolbarView layout, searchable past sessions, Adw.StatusPage empty state, tactile floating composer with context chips and @ mentions, 30ms throttled streaming Markdown, collapsible reasoning row, and syntax-highlighted GtkSourceView code blocks.
Codebase Audit & Optimization: Unified Flatpak/bytes helpers, cached compiled regular expressions, and added HTTP session timeouts.

description.p: Release 0.41.0 improves MCP automation, offline LaTeX and Quarto builds, scientific toolchains, and enterprise security controls:

ul.li: CLI and MCP D-Bus Bridge: Added --mcp-server to --help and connected stdio MCP clients to active GUI windows over D-Bus.
Headless MCP Tools: Added file_path support, compile_latex, get_environment_summary, read-only mode, and canonical path checks.
Quarto and Tectonic Offline Readiness: Fixed QUARTO_DENO_DOM paths, added Tectonic bundle warmup during setup, and added an offline readiness check in Preferences.
Scientific Packages and Profiles: Expanded default Python and R packages, added domain profiles, and added external Conda environment discovery.
Security Guardrails: Added Air-Gapped Mode, PHI/PII Data Lock, policy.json administrator locks, Free LLM RAM control, and lfm25-1.2b model naming.

description.p: Most Stable Release (v0.40.0): Transitions Imladris Core to the Apache-2.0 Hybrid Open-Core license for frictionless Academic & Enterprise R&D adoption, and delivers major editor and Flatpak stability upgrades:

ul.li: Apache-2.0 Hybrid Open-Core Licensing: Relicensed core studio from GPL-3.0-or-later to Apache-2.0 with explicit patent protection, clean JSC.Context/MCP extension boundaries, and Commercial Enterprise Pack readiness.

VS Code & RStudio-Grade Autocompletion: Live keystroke refiltering, fuzzy match highlighting, Markdown/Quarto prose snippets & cross-references (@fig-*, @tbl-*, @sec-*), HTML5 tag & smart closing tag completion, R library()/parameter completions, Python DataFrame methods, live REPL DataFrame column discovery, and paired BackSpace/triple-backtick handling.
Quick Table Picker Popover: Cursor-anchored 8x8 hover grid and custom Rows/Cols dialog (Ctrl+Alt+T) with format-aware Markdown, HTML, LaTeX, and RTF table generation.
Flatpak WebKitGTK 6.0 Live Preview Fix: Fixed WebKitWebContext vs. JSC.Context initialization order so live preview renders reliably in Flatpak sandboxes.

description.p: Release v0.33.1 introduces Apple TextEdit-style WYSIWYG .rtf editing, rock-solid WebKitGTK 6.0 live preview across Flatpak and host builds, unified single-package toolchains, and a comprehensive security and C/Vala memory audit:

ul.li: WYSIWYG Rich Text (.rtf) Editor: Added native RTF 1.x codec (RtfCodec) and TextEdit-style formatting bar (RtfEditorView) supporting font family/size, Bold/Italic/Underline/Strikethrough (Ctrl+B/I/U), text and highlight colors, paragraph alignment, bullet lists, and live WebKitGTK 6.0 preview.

WebKitGTK 6.0 Preview & Flatpak Parity: Fixed GTK4 unrealize/map reparenting across Apostrophe and RStudio modes, zero-allocation deferral during revealer/paned transitions, cancelled-load filtering, proportional editor-to-preview scroll sync, and synchronized Flatpak finish-args.
Unified Single-Package Distribution: Merged scientific runtime dependencies (R, Python, pip/venv, Pandoc, curl, bzip2, git) directly into the main .deb, .rpm, AUR PKGBUILD, and Nix Flake packages.

Security & Privacy Hardening: Defaulted AI configuration to local/offline (Ollama), removed process-wide GALAXY_API_KEY propagation, enforced 0600 permissions on recovery .shadow files, sanitized bioinformatics/Galaxy code generators, and hardened C export bounds and UTF-8 handling in export_native.c.

Scientific & Citation Fixes: Fixed Zotero/DOI bibliography path resolution (bibliography/references.bib), CAYW locator conversion, PubMed BibTeX escaping, pre-2007 arXiv IDs, session refcount cleanup, and inline math/code rendering order.

description.p: Release v0.33.0 delivers researcher, data scientist, and first-time writer improvements:

ul.li: LaTeX & Citation Fixes: 3-pass BibTeX/Biber builds, HeaderBar TeX engine selection, native .tex PDF export, arXiv ID lookup, and .tex-aware @ citation completion.
DataGridViewer & Polyglot Notebooks: RFC-4180 CSV/TSV parsing, local-file pagination, R rownames, NA-safe sorting, polyglot environment preservation, and Alt+- / Ctrl+Shift+M shortcuts.
UI/UX Polish: Fixed Preferences AI provider mapping (all 19 providers), Command Palette tokenized search & shortcuts, Libadwaita Keyboard Shortcuts dialog (Ctrl+?), and Skip-aware onboarding tour.

description.p: Release v0.32.0 adds publisher LaTeX templates, academic citation styles, a first-launch feature tour, open-source presentation decks, and security/stability hardening:

ul.li: Top 10 LaTeX Publisher Templates & Citation Styles: IEEE, ACM, Springer LNCS, Elsevier, Nature, PLOS, APS, NeurIPS, ICML, and MDPI paired with 10 citation styles.
First-Launch Feature Tour: GNOME Tour-style onboarding carousel shown on first startup and via Feature Tour in the app menu.
Open-Source Presentation & Beamer Decks: Added LaTeX Beamer, Marp/Lecture Markdown, and TypeScript Reveal.js/Slidev templates.
Security, FFI & UI Hardening: Fixed FFI strv termination, outline regex null-dereference, subprocess escaping, archive traversal parsing, and Pango markup warnings.

description.p: Release v0.31.1 fixes a crash when creating a new document:

ul.li: Fixed a segmentation fault in DocumentPage.ensure_bundled_language_specs() where a non-null-terminated GLib.GenericArray<string>.data pointer array was passed to GtkSource.LanguageManager.set_search_path(), replacing it with a null-terminated Vala string[] array.

description.p: Release v0.31.0 introduces interactive Micromamba toolchain setup on startup, multi-version Python switching, and out-of-the-box PDF/ODT/RTF export:

ul.li: Interactive Micromamba Setup & Updates: Select only Python, R, LaTeX, HTML/CSS, TypeScript, and Quarto on first launch, update installed components, or install/switch to older Python versions (3.12, 3.11, 3.10, 3.9).
Native C Linux Toolchain Backend: Fast uname(2), statvfs(2), fts(3) hardlink-deduplicated disk usage, and conda-meta version detection.

Built-in PDF, ODT, and RTF Export: Added a native Cairo/Pango A4 PDF report renderer and zero-dependency zlib OASIS ZIP packager so PDF, ODT, and RTF exports succeed out of the box without external CLI tools.

description.p: Release v0.30.0 expands format-aware editing, Elrond AI model control, local inference, and optional toolchain setup:

ul.li: Additional Document Formats: Added format detection and editor profiles for plain text, CSV, TSV, RStudio projects (.Rproj), and bibliography files.
AI Model Controls: Discover and select Gemini models, tune response detail and temperature, or download curated Hugging Face GGUF models for managed llama.cpp.
Low-Memory Local Inference: Compact models use capped context and quantized KV caches, CPU-only inference, one sequence, and retained mmap defaults; this reduces memory use but is not a hard RSS cap.
Optional Toolchains: Choose the micromamba install folder and select only the R, Python, Quarto, Node/TypeScript, and TeX components needed.
Pure Vala/C Native Core: Replaced the Rust FFI layer with native Vala/GLib parsing and rendering, removing Cargo build overhead and streamlining Flatpak builds.
Elrond Routing: Configured cloud-provider requests are no longer intercepted by a ready local Elrond server.

description.p: Release v0.27.1 resolves Flatpak/CI offline Rust build failures and FlatPark packaging synchronization:

ul.li: CI & Offline Cargo Fix: Anchored .gitignore build/repo rules and restored complete vendored syn test sources so offline Flatpak and GitHub Actions builds succeed reliably.
FlatPark & Toolchain Extension Fix: Synchronized release metadata and marked the optional Toolchain Flatpak add-on with no-autodownload=true to prevent install blocks.

description.p: Release v0.27.0 expands Elrond AI, Rust core manuscript analytics, Quarto engines, and Linux distribution packaging:

ul.li: Elrond AI Routing & Streaming: Added local intent routing, multi-turn conversation history, and SSE token streaming.
Rust Core & Quarto Analytics: Added zero-copy line parsing, expanded Quarto engines/options, and exposed imladris_analyze_manuscript_json via VAPI and NativeCore.
Distribution Toolchain Packaging: Added toolchain meta-packages (.deb/.rpm), Flatpak Toolchain add-on extension, and updated landing page documentation.

description.p: Release v0.26.0 introduces the hybrid Rust core (imladris_core) + Vala/GTK4 architecture, format-adaptive UI across all 7 scientific formats (.qmd, .Rmd, .ipynb, .md, .tex, .ts, .html), sequential chunk execution, LaTeX/TypeScript runners, and Flatpak/security hardening:

ul.li: Hybrid Rust Core (imladris_core): CommonMark + GFM + math/mermaid rendering, lossless Jupyter (.ipynb) round-trip serialization, YAML frontmatter, LaTeX, and TypeScript symbol analyzers over C-ABI.
Format-Adaptive UI & Syntax Highlighting: FormatProfile-driven ribbon, headerbar, comments, citations, and embedded GtkSourceView 5 language specs for Quarto, R Markdown, LaTeX, and TypeScript.

Polyglot Execution & Compilers: Per-project/tab PersistentSessionManager pool, sequential Gtk.TextMark chunk execution, LatexBuildRunner (.log diagnostics), TypeScriptRunner (tsc/tsx/node/deno/bun), and polyglot R + Python EnvironmentController.

Flatpak & Security Hardening: Unified Flatpak permissions (--talk-name=org.freedesktop.Flatpak), hardened Mallorn/plugin archive validation, sanitized CRAN/GitHub package installation, and atomic RecoveryService.

description.p: Release v0.25.0 introduces Free-Tier AI APIs with Automatic Quota Failover, GitHub Copilot OAuth login, Positron/RStudio-style Direct Editor Writing, and comprehensive security, stability, and documentation improvements:

ul.li: Functions Added — Free-Tier AI APIs & Automatic Quota Failover: Built-in support for Groq, Cerebras, OpenRouter Free, GitHub Models, and FreeLLMAPI Local Proxy with automatic HTTP 429 cascading and explicit privacy opt-in (free_api_consent_accepted).

Functions Added — GitHub Copilot OAuth Device Flow: Native RFC 8628 GitHub Device Flow authentication (CopilotAuthService) with secure libsecret token storage and OpenAI-compatible Copilot chat completions.

Functions Added — Positron/RStudio-Style Direct Editor Writing: New AiBufferEditHelper and ElrondChatPanel direct-buffer actions (Apply to Selection, Update Active Chunk, Improve Writing, Refactor Code, Fix Syntax) preserving Quarto #| cell options and single-step Ctrl+Z undo.

Improvements — Elrond AI Workflow & Product Positioning: Replaced legacy inline editing popover with unified direct-buffer Elrond workflow; updated About dialog, AppStream metadata, desktop keywords, and packaging descriptions.
Improvements — Zero-Phone-Home Startup & Privacy: PackageIndexCache now loads on demand instead of probing network endpoints at launch.

Bugs Fixed — Security & Sandboxing: Gated MCP execute_code behind IMLADRIS_MCP_ALLOW_EXEC=1 with strict binary allowlisting (Rscript, python3, quarto); isolated GALAXY_API_KEY in subprocesses; mitigated Mallorn Zip Slip path traversal; replaced shell-interpolated micromamba download with Soup.Session + libarchive extraction.

Bugs Fixed — Editor, UI & Concurrency: Stripped \uFFFC widget anchor characters during file save; fixed dock popout widget stealing and tab-close window leaks; fixed CommandPaletteDialog action prefix mismatches; eliminated DocumentAdapter static race conditions.

description.p: Release v0.24.2 bundles all missing Papirus symbolic icons inside the application resource archive:

ul.li: Complete Bundled Icon Pack: Embeds all 118 required Papirus symbolic SVG icons via GResource so toolbar, dock, and dialog icons render reliably on any desktop icon theme.

description.p: Release v0.24.1 updates the project homepage and website metadata:

ul.li: Homepage Redirect Fix: Points AppStream, FlatPark, About dialog, and distribution package URLs to the official landing page.

description.p: Release v0.24.0 resolves Live Preview rendering across .qmd, .md, .Rmd, and .html documents on GTK4 and WebKitGTK 6.0:

ul.li: WebKitGTK 6.0 & GTK4 Compatibility: Prevents GSK_RENDERER=gl overrides in Auto mode and avoids HardwareAccelerationPolicy.ALWAYS stalls when DMA-BUF rendering is disabled.

Lifecycle-Safe Dock Reparenting: Preserves mounted WebKitWebView state in RStudioDockGrid without forced unmap/unrealize cycles, and defers initial HTML/URI loads until the WebView is mapped with a valid allocation.

Quarto (.qmd) & RMarkdown (.Rmd) State Machine: Preserves extension identity for unsaved buffers, activates Live Preview across any quadrant, and reconciles missing panels in existing dock-layout.json files.
Quarto HTML Adapter Fixes: Prevents multi-line code chunks from being mangled as Markdown paragraphs and adds support for Quarto fenced callout blocks.

description.p: Release v0.23.0 delivers a comprehensive GNOME/Libadwaita interface overhaul, redesigned Elrond AI copilot and code assistance, new workspace customization options in Preferences, and rock-solid WebKitGTK 6.0 preview rendering:

ul.li: GNOME & Libadwaita HIG Redesign: Streamlines the welcome view with progressive disclosure, providing high-visibility Quick Start cards (Quarto Notebook, R Script/Shiny, Open Folder) alongside a collapsible expander for specialized templates (.Rmd, .ipynb, .Rproj, .mallorn).

Zero-Chrome Distraction-Free Empty State: Automatically conceals toolbar ribbons, document tab bar, and bottom status bar on startup or when all tabs are closed, maximizing screen estate and visual clarity.

Redesigned Elrond AI Copilot: Features a new active provider status pill in the chat header, multi-context chips (Active File, Selection, Data, Last Error), formatted inline Markdown with Pango markup, and interactive code action cards (Insert at Cursor, Run in Console, Copy).

Unified Local & Cloud AI Engine: Automatically routes prompts through local ElrondEngineController when available, seamlessly falling back to configured cloud providers (Gemini, Claude, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, Ollama, LM Studio) or Antigravity harnesses.

Preview-First Inline Assistance: Re-engineers the Ctrl+Shift+E editor prompt popover with quick-action pills (Fix & Clean, Add Comments, Explain, R Plot) and a live monospace preview box with one-click Replace Selection or Insert at Cursor.
Decluttered 4-Pane Workbench Dock: Replaces crowded quadrant header buttons with clean maximize and overflow popover menus for minimizing, undocking, and quadrant rearrangement.

Preferences Workspace Controls: Adds dedicated settings for 4-Pane Studio vs. Focus Mode layout, ribbon toolbar visibility, bottom status bar visibility, and default editor zoom percentage with live-updating compact zoom controls.

WebKitGTK 6.0 Preview Stability: Eliminates blank preview panes across Wayland and GTK 4.18+ through DMABUF fallback handling, GL renderer standardization, ONDEMAND GPU policy, and base URI resolution.
Performance & Memory Safety: Resolves GLib.Bytes slice boundaries, asynchronous FIFO command queue deadlocks, and GObject singleton signal handler leaks.

description.p: Release v0.22.0 introduces hardware-accelerated rendering and a comprehensive GNOME/Libadwaita interface overhaul:

ul.li: Configures GTK4 GSK hardware acceleration (OpenGL NGL and Vulkan SPIR-V pipelines) via settings.ini before Display initialization with graceful CPU Cairo fallback.
Adds configurable animation and frame physics with three profiles: Alacritty Crisp (65ms zero-lag micro-transitions), PuTTY Instant (0ms zero-latency snap), and Libadwaita Smooth (180ms easing).
Introduces non-blinking steady terminal/editor cursor mode synchronizing across source editor and REPL consoles.
Implements Universal Command Palette (Ctrl+Shift+P / Ctrl+K) providing fuzzy-matched execution of workbench actions, statistical bridges, and hardware toggles.
Integrates inline code chunk execution runtime duration telemetry directly into document cards (Out [n]: ✔ ms/s).
Resolves Pango markup entities and unescaped ampersands across all preferences, popovers, and headerbars according to GNOME HIG standards.
Bundles 9 missing symbolic SVG icons directly into GResource (book-open, character-map, emblem-ok, format-text-superscript, send, software-properties, text-html, view-column, view-statistics).
Synchronizes GtkSourceView 5 syntax color schemes and dynamic styling with user-selected GNOME accent colors.

description.p: Release v0.21.0 introduces zero-latency, 100% offline VS Code-grade polyglot IntelliSense and intelligent bracket/quote pairing: Implements non-AI deterministic completion engine (CodeIntelliSenseEngine) with multi-paradigm symbol catalogs for R (base, stats, tidyverse, survival, DESeq2), Python (builtins, pandas, numpy, matplotlib, scipy.stats), Quarto hash-pipe (#|) cell options, YAML frontmatter directives, and LaTeX/mhchem math macros; features live buffer AST scanning for user-defined variables and functions, active REPL session object introspection, and dataframe column accessors (df$col); adds VS Code subsequence fuzzy scoring with prefix boost; integrates BracketAutoPairController for smart auto-closure of brackets (), [], {} and quotes "", '', ``, cursor overtype skip-over, and selection wrapping; provides manual completion invocation via Ctrl+Space; and includes preference toggles in SettingsManager.

Release v0.20.0 introduces the Elbereth Clinical Biostatistics, Power Calculation & Survival Studio with critical stability and workflow improvements: Adds Elbereth popover supporting ICH E9 sample size calculations (two-sample t-test, binomial proportions, and Schoenfeld 1983 log-rank survival) with live Cairo Power Curve plotting, regulatory SAP justifications, and automated R/Python verification chunks; integrates CDISC ADSL Table 1, ADTTE survival (Kaplan-Meier + Cox PH), subgroup forest plots, and differential expression volcano plots; resolves R Markdown comma-delimited chunk header parsing ({r, echo=FALSE}) and #| eval: false execution skipping; connects REPL-generated plots to Quadrant 4 Plot Gallery; fixes inline chunk output clearing and tab-delimited (.tsv) dataset imports; auto-generates cryptographic SHA-256 GxP provenance manifests on export; and adds clinical trial SAP and RNA-Seq starter templates.

Release v0.19.0 transforms Imladris into an enterprise-grade production workbench: Introduces Taniquetil (AlphaFold DB structural biology bridge) with native Cairo pLDDT per-residue confidence track and Bio3D/PAE code generation; integrates Yavanna Bio-Entity & Oligo resolver; implements cryptographic SHA-256 GxP and EU CRA provenance attestation service (imladris-provenance.lock.json); resolves multi-thread MCP server memory safety through GLib MainContext marshaling; adds asynchronous FIFO execution queues to PersistentSessionManager eliminating G_IO_ERROR_PENDING stream collisions; and delivers vectorized 1,000-row pagination with column data type profiling in DataGridViewer.

Release v0.18.0 introduces the Arekyer Galaxy-to-Quarto Provenance Bridge, MathChemStudio, Rproj Project scaffolding, and Jupyter Notebook parity: Implements Arekyer (Imladris.Bridges.Arekyer) connecting upstream cloud bioinformatics histories to local reproducible documents with verifiable httr2 and pandas data loaders; integrates secure credential management via libsecret-1 OS keyring with isolated subprocess memory injection; adds MathChemStudio with natural syntax for mathematical and chemical formulas with dual-target LaTeX and Markdown export; enables creation and lifecycle management of native RStudio .Rproj project files; and establishes full feature parity across Jupyter Notebook (.ipynb) source structures.

Release v0.17.0 introduces the native Galaxy Project API & BioBlend Integration: Connects upstream bioinformatics cloud histories directly to the local workbench via asynchronous REST APIs; provides a dedicated Galaxy History Inspector in Quadrant 3 with live dataset state tracking (ok, running, queued, error); implements single-click reproducible code chunk generation into active Quarto (.qmd) and R Markdown (.Rmd) documents for R (httr) and Python (requests and pandas); adds a Libadwaita Galaxy authentication preferences dialog with instant server validation; and hardens credential storage according to GDPR Article 25 and EU Cyber Resilience Act standards.

Release v0.16.0 delivers comprehensive codebase deduplication, optimization, and stability refactoring: Eliminates redundant and dormant code across ExportService, RibbonFactory, and ChunkExecutionEngine; refactors DocumentPage buffer change debouncing and snapshot caching to eliminate redundant string memory copies; introduces pre-compiled regular expressions for Markdown formatting and Shiny URL parsing; optimizes Flatpak host runtime resolution to avoid duplicate IPC roundtrips; secures DataGridViewer column lifecycle against UI thread blocking; and improves multi-language code block detection across Julia, SQL, Bash, TypeScript, and Python.

Release v0.15.2 introduces complete R Shiny interactive web application support matching RStudio workbench capabilities: Real-time Shiny app detection across app.R, server.R, ui.R, and inline reactive notebooks; context-aware HeaderBar 'Run App' / 'Stop' execution controls with Ctrl+Shift+A shortcut; multi-target display engine supporting the embedded Viewer Pane in Quadrant 4, a dedicated standalone Adw.Window, and the user's default external browser; dynamic ephemeral port allocation and stdout/stderr stream interception; and built-in modern bslib sidebar Shiny templates accessible from the primary menu and welcome dashboard.

Release v0.15.1 incorporates deep GNOME architectural debugging and stability improvements: Resolves GObject circular reference memory cycles in citation completion; secures code chunk signal disconnections with try-finally execution guards; adds graceful persistent session shutdown routines to eliminate zombie subshell processes; guarantees stream and descriptor closure in REPL bridges; adds non-blocking timeout wrappers for binary checks; harmonizes license declarations to GPL-3.0-or-later; and resolves GTK4 widget class compiler warnings.

Release v0.15.0 delivers full functional parity with RStudio across the 4-quadrant workbench docking system: Introduces interactive Command History tracking with project-level .Rhistory synchronization, readline Up/Down navigation, and history export; adds the dedicated History panel (Quadrant 3) and Packages manager panel (Quadrant 4) with live library attach/detach toggles; upgrades Plots to a multi-plot gallery deck with Previous/Next navigation, zoom popout window, image/PDF export, and clipboard copy; adds complete Files workspace actions (New Folder, New File, Delete, Rename, and Set Working Directory); integrates the Help documentation browser with R Rd2HTML pipeline; refines Environment categorization into Data (with 1-click View), Values, and Functions with live search and CSV/text dataset import; and implements cell execution controls (Run Chunks Above, Clear Console) with custom keyboard shortcuts.

Release v0.14.1 resolves critical live preview display and application crash issues, and introduces direct Pandoc-powered document exports: Fixes GLib-GIO file opening crash by implementing HANDLES_OPEN and application open hooks; resolves Gtk.IconTheme display singleton assertion crash; resolves WebKit WebProcess crash loops and pane width squashing on laptop displays; hardens WebKit local file access and sandbox configuration; adds native Pandoc HTML (standalone with embedded resources) and PDF export pipeline with graceful fallback renderers; and sanitizes Pango markup escaping across preferences and plugin views.

Release v0.14.0 introduces three major workbench pillars: (1) R and Python Global Environment Management with broom clear confirmation, dynamic object querying, and an interactive virtualized Dataframe & Matrix Viewer backed by GtkColumnView and GioListStore with View(x) hooks; (2) Customizable detachable workbench layout engine supporting 2x2 Quad, Left Tall, and Right Tall topologies, standalone floating window undocking and automatic re-docking, and layout preset persistence in ~/.config/imladris/layouts/; and (3) Integrated Elrond AI Copilot tab in the bottom-left quadrant with context toggle chips (+Active File, +Dataframe Schemas, +Last Error), streamed chat history, and one-click 'Insert at Cursor' and 'Run in Console' code actions.

Release v0.13.1 brings critical security hardening, memory safety, and live preview rendering fixes: Resolves WebKitGTK 6.0 inner sandbox credential handshake collisions in containerized environments ensuring reliable live preview; adds base URI directory resolution for relative images and stylesheets; introduces automatic WebProcess crash recovery; hardens plugin ID validation against directory traversal and blocks symlink expansion during archive extraction; secures workspace file access against path traversal; optimizes real-time word counting to zero-allocation streaming; cleans up deprecated Libadwaita expander row icons; and implements application window close resource cleanup.

Release v0.13.0 introduces an Obsidian-style JavaScript Extension & Plugin Engine powered by JavaScriptCore (JSC.Context): Enables lightweight, isolated JavaScript plugins with onload/onunload lifecycle hooks; provides declarative imladris bridge exposing native toasts, dynamic ribbon buttons in the Extensions ribbon group, safe GtkSource.Buffer read/insert actions, gated R and Python console execution, and Elrond AI queries; supports one-click bundle imports (.implugin and .zip) with permission and GPLv3 license consent modals; and adds an Extensions management page in Preferences.

Release v0.12.2 delivers the complete Conventional Software Architecture and Engineering Audit refactoring: Eliminates dormant proto-code and uncalled methods in MallornManager and ElrondEngineController; resolves GObject lifecycle memory retention across document tabs via Adw.TabView close_page hooks and explicit signal disconnection; fixes syntax language mapping for .qmd files in GtkSourceView; eliminates whole-document string duplication in frontmatter parsing; resolves nested block formatting in basic_markdown_to_html; optimizes host command generation; and synchronizes MCP server protocol metadata.

Release v0.12.1 resolves container exit 127 issues and streamlines multimedia insertion: Transitions Elrond AI into a robust Smart Local Server & Agent Harness Bridge supporting Ollama (:11434), LM Studio (:1234), Cherry Studio / LocalAI (:23333 / :8080), and host Antigravity CLI (agy); introduces an interactive file picker dialog for images and videos with automatic asset copying to the project's /img subfolder in sandboxed projects; supports format-aware Quarto video shortcodes and HTML5 video rendering in live preview; and adds an About Imladris dialog with documentation links, ecosystem credits, and Gemini Assistance acknowledgment.

Release v0.12.0 introduces major enhancements across AI architecture, GNOME 51 integration, and layout flexibility: Reworks the internal llama.cpp engine with soname symlink preservation, Flatpak host fallback, and 60-second health handshakes; modernizes UI spinners to Adw.Spinner with GNOME 51 platform targeting; adds user preferences for inline AI editing popovers and dynamic Left/Right side panel docking; bundles official vector SVG brand logos across all frontier and local AI models; and publishes the full architectural blueprint and bug localization matrix.

Release v0.11.0 delivers enhanced UX controls and comprehensive performance optimizations: Introduces an intuitive 3-stop slider (Low, Medium, High) for Elrond Assistance Level, automatic host distribution detection displaying tailored llama.cpp installation commands across Debian, Fedora, Arch, openSUSE, Solus, and NixOS, and dual backend switching between Vulkan and NVIDIA CUDA. Also includes major codebase deduplication and performance tuning, caching telemetry size calculations, extracting the standalone PackageIndexCache service, and removing dormant legacy code.

Release v0.10.0 introduces the unified 'Write with Elrond Assistance (AI)' zero-configuration local copilot and telemetry status bar monitor. Features automatic Qwen2.5-Coder-3B model bootstrapping, zero-setup llama-server lifecycle management with Vulkan GPU offloading and CPU fallback, real-time RAM/VRAM telemetry polling every 2 seconds, editor context menu action and Ctrl+Shift+E shortcut. Also introduces the dedicated top 'Packages' Ribbon Tab with live prefix autocomplete, ETag disk caching, O(log N) binary search, pak and uv fast-path installation, and automatic sandboxed lockfile synchronization.

Release v0.9.0 introduces the Automated micromamba Data Science Toolchain Manager and 4-tier runtime resolution hierarchy (Project Sandbox → Managed Global Toolchain → Host Flatpak Spawn → Host Native). Provides one-click automated installation of R 4.4 with dev compilers, IRkernel, pre-compiled tidyverse, Python 3.12 with uv, and Quarto CLI into user storage ($XDG_DATA_HOME/imladris/toolchains/) with zero root permissions and zero host compilation errors. Enables completely self-contained execution on clean Linux installations inside Flatpak containers.

Release v0.8.0 introduces transparent host R interpreter discovery and execution support inside Flatpak sandboxes via the flatpak-spawn host portal, shared host-sandbox cache directory (~/.cache/imladris) for graphics plots and temporary scripts, and real-time package compilation log streaming to the interactive console pane.

Release v0.7.0 brings the complete 11-pillar expansion, modernized Libadwaita Ribbon menu with 5 consolidated high-density tabs and collapsible deck (Ctrl+F1), appearance theming with GNOME default accent colors, and a vastly expanded AI Assistant subsystem: First-class support for Google Gemini (AI Studio and Google OAuth token), Claude (Anthropic Messages API with thinking blocks), OpenAI (GPT-4o, o1, o3-mini), Cursor API compatibility, NVIDIA NIM cloud endpoints, DeepSeek (including DeepSeek-R1 reasoning stream extraction), Kimi (Moonshot AI), Qwen (Alibaba DashScope), Ollama, and LM Studio local server with persistent user credentials; clean launch modal with clean UI labels, context-aware ribbon state machine, RStudio-style package installer for CRAN and PyPI, interactive R and Python persistent consoles with inline chunk output cards and plot rendering, automatic pwd synchronization, sandboxed project engine with RStudio and Jupyter export, 1:1 DCF parity for .mallorn bundles, and headless ODT/ODP pipeline.

Release v0.6.0 introduces the 6 core pillars: Categorized creation pop-up dialog with 9 creation targets, sandboxed vs standard project engines (renv and venv isolation), the 1:1 RStudio-compatible .mallorn exchange format, and comprehensive ODT and ODP OpenDocument export pipelines.
Release v0.5.1 standardizes the canonical Flatpak and Freedesktop Application ID to io.github.Antux912012.Imladris and includes the Phase 1.1.3 RStudio 4-Quadrant Drag-and-Drop Docking System.
